verdict.rationale: Bento is an email marketing platform, so deliverability monitoring is a fair question, but the evidence never shows per-send bounce, complaint, or blocklist reporting, or any guidance when deliverability degrades. The closest items are adjacent: DNS authentication setup, dedicated IP options, broadcast history review, and a marketing line about 'deliverability nerds'. None of these is the requested signal-and-guidance capability.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
